messages:
infra-bot: [ALERT] gpu.ecc.correctable_rate spiking on ap-se2-gpu-pool-7 node gpu-37. metric triggered at 2003456720.

alice: seeing the alert, scheduler already started moving pods off gpu-37. Not many evictions yet.

omar: looking at node logs: repeated PCIe link resets + NVLINK timeout events. dmesg excerpt: 
```
[ 1234.567890] pcieport 0000:04:00.0: PME Acknowledge error
[ 1234.568123] nvidia 0000:04:00.0: NvLink reset detected
[ 1234.568456] Correctable ECC errors increased: 476 -> 1290 in last 10m
```

priya: is this impacting hosted text-gen latency for ap-southeast-2?

ben: p50 p95 stepped up ~20ms/120ms respectively for text-gen routes in that region since alert. Error rates increased for large-batch jobs. Traffic fallback kicked in for low-priority routes.

alice: proposed plan: cordon+drain node, shift batch-heavy jobs to eu-west fallback, spin up hotpool GPUs if available, schedule RMA for board/PCIe riser. Who can run the drain?

omar: I can run it now. Note: some Dedicated sessions pinned to that node - need manual migration or force stop. Expect ~10-15m for most pods, longer for reserved sessions.

priya: customer comms: I'll draft a note for affected Dedicated customers and ask sales to standby. We should avoid a public incident page if routing keeps latency within SLA.

ben: quick commands to run: 
```
kubectl cordon node/gpu-37
kubectl drain node/gpu-37 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
```

omar: starting cordon+drain at 2003457000. Evictions in progress. Eviction log sample: 
- evicting pod job-batch-294 (grace 120s)
- evicting dedicated-session-22 (held by kube-rescheduler) -> manual intervention may be needed

alice: if dedicated sessions block, prioritize moving them to spare pool instead of killing. Use `rescheduler migrate --node gpu-37 --to spare-pool` where possible. If not possible after 2m, force terminate.

omar: eviction progress 78% at 2003457160. One long-running dedicated session hanging (session-22). Will attempt rescheduler migration.

ben: creating hotpool capacity in ap-se2 with 4 GPUs (est attach 6-8m). Cost note: keeping hotpool up ~+$1.2k/day if sustained. Will monitor and scale down when stable.

priya: draft to customers ready, sending to two Dedicated accounts now. Notifying @sales and @account-management.

omar: drain complete at 2003458200. Node marked MAINT. Pulling logs for vendor: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.total,utilization.gpu,voltage --format=csv` returned noisy telemetry.

ben: vendor ticket opened (VT-8932). Preliminary vendor advice: board-level RMA likely; may be PCIe riser or NVLink bridge causing intermittent resets. ETA parts 24-48h.

alice: schedule RMA tomorrow 08:00 local. We'll keep node out of rotation until replacement and 2h soak test pass. Ben, you'll run soak tests and uncordon on success?

ben: yes. Test plan: stress-ng + CUDA compute loop for 2h, monitor ecc counters and nvlink resets. If stable, uncordon and rejoin pool. If flaps recur, escalate for chassis-level swap.

priya: customers acknowledged. No immediate SLA hits reported; they saw increased tail latency but not failures. We're not creating a public incident page.

alice: owners: Omar (drain & local ops), Ben (fallback routing, hotpool, soak tests), Priya (customer comms & RMA coord), Alice (incident lead).

infra-bot: [UPDATE] drain completed at 2003458200. Node gpu-37 set to MAINT by omar.

omar: vendor accepted RMA, parts ETA 24h. Filing follow-up action: check rack-level riser cables + run firmware audit across the rack (NVLINK fw last flashed 2025-09-01).

ben: spun up hotpool, traffic shift held at ~8% to eu-west while we stabilize to keep latencies within target. Cost hit tracked in `infra/ops/costs/2026-03` for review.

alice: closing notes: we avoided customer-facing outage due to fallback routing, but root cause appears to be degrading PCIe/NVLink path causing ECC correctable spikes. Action items: 1) RMA gpu-37 2) run riser cable audit for rack-7 3) add nvlink firmware consistency check to preflight 4) review autoscale hotpool policy to reduce cost during short incidents.

priya: will create follow-up ticket with owners and timelines.

alice: thanks all. Will re-open if flapping resumes after bring-up. :thumbsup:
